title: Near-Misses in Gambling

lines.text: Surprisingly, near-misses actually make people want to gamble more.
Researchers used a simplified slot machine task to study this phenomenon.
Near-misses, though not winning, still boost the desire to play.
This effect is stronger when the player feels they had control.
Brain scans show near-misses activate reward areas, like wins do.
This activity correlates with higher gambling propensity, as shown by self-reports.

sources: Clark L, Lawrence AJ, Astley-Jones F, Gray N (2009). Gambling near-misses enhance motivation to gamble and recruit win-related brain circuitry. Neuron 61(3):481-490. PMID 19217383
